HOW TO RUN THE CODE:
Recommended to use Python 3.11 (3.12 can have issues with Pygame)

REQUIRED PYTHON LIBARRIES:
pygame, matplotlib, pandas

WATCH TRAINED AGENTS PLAY:
Run the files - 
visualise_500.py (500 rally checkpoint)
visualise_15000.py (15,000 rally checkpoint)
visualise_30000.py (30,000 rally checkpoint)

IMPORTANT:
If there are issues with the trained agents, make sure you are running the file from inside the correct directory.
It must be the same folder (/env) or it will not find the saved models!! Any issues then run the command to train agents again below.

TRAIN THE AGENTS:
Run command: 
python train.py --rallies 30,000
(estimated 2 mins run time)

SOME CONTROLS:
SPACE to pause
R to reset
ESC to quit

PLOT TRAINING PROGRESS AS A FIGURE:
Run the file plot_results.py
(must run training first, or it will just use the existing excel file generated by me)
